title: Morning Prep for Lamp Repair
summary: On Saturday morning you eat oatmeal with banana and tea while reviewing a lamp wiring sketch. You wrap the broken desk lamp and a screwdriver set in a canvas tote, then take an umbrella and jacket before leaving home.

title: Tram Line 4 to Fernhollow
summary: You walk to the tram stop with an umbrella under your arm, then ride tram line 4. You mutter half to yourself about which stop to get off at; the display reads 'Line 4 · Fernhollow'.

title: Checking In at Repair Cafe
summary: At Fernhollow Repair Cafe you greet a volunteer and fill in a paper intake form for the desk lamp, listing the problem as flickering and a cracked switch.

title: Opening the Lamp Base
summary: You open the lamp base, removing four screws, and inspect the wiring with a volunteer. The volunteer finds the rocker switch cracked inside and arcing; the cord looks fine, so they get a multimeter.

title: Testing Cord Continuity
summary: A volunteer teaches you to test the cord for continuity with a multimeter; it beeps, meaning the cord is good. You discuss the strain relief knot that keeps the cord from pulling on the wires inside the base.

title: Coffee Break at Tea Corner
summary: During coffee at the tea corner, you chat with a volunteer about the Saturday schedule, a spare-parts bin, and a toaster. You pause the recording for a break and say you will return at one.

title: Searching Spare Parts
summary: Back after a pause, you and a volunteer search the spare-parts bin for a matching rocker switch. Nothing fits the lamp's cutout, so the search continues.

title: Ordering a Replacement Switch
summary: The volunteer decides to order a replacement rocker switch, expected Tuesday, and will text you the tracking number. You agree to leave the lamp at the cafe until then.

title: Tying the Strain-Relief Knot
summary: You focus on re-seating the cord and tying a strain-relief knot inside the lamp base, tidying the wires. A volunteer comments occasionally; the four base screws stay in a small dish.

title: Tagging the Lamp for Parts
summary: You put the four screws on the lid of a red toolbox so you don't lose them. A volunteer confirms the toolbox stays until Tuesday, shelves the lamp with a blue tag on the waiting-for-parts shelf, and you say goodbye.

title: Bakery Stop for Bread and Buns
summary: You walk a few blocks in light drizzle, then at Quill Street Bakery the cashier recommends the warm cinnamon buns. You buy a rye loaf and two cinnamon buns, leaning your umbrella against the counter.

title: Library Hold and Manual Browsing
summary: After a short walk with the bakery bag, you enter Larkspur Community Library. Staff says the lamp repair manual will be ready Tuesday afternoon and renews your library card. You browse a small appliance repair book in the reading room.

title: Tram Home in Evening Rain
summary: You ride tram line 4 home in the evening rain, holding the bakery bag on your lap. You mutter a reminder to yourself about Tuesday, mostly drowned out by noise.

title: Evening at Home and Tuesday Prep
summary: Back home, you lean the wet umbrella by the door and set down the bakery bag. You have soup with rye bread, then a cinnamon bun. You record a voice note for Tuesday's switch and manual pickups, and write tomorrow's list.
